channelsMediaOnly: The channels where only media attachments can be sent.
channelsIgnoreAll: Channels I should ignore for all types of logging.
channelsIgnoreMessageDelete: Channels I should ignore when checking for deleted messages to log.
channelsIgnoreMessageEdit: Channels I should ignore when checking for edited messages to log.
channelsIgnoreReactionAdd: Channels I should ignore when checking for added reactions.
channelsLogsChannelCreate: The channel for channel creation logs, if set, I will send a message when another channel is created.
channelsLogsChannelDelete: The channel for channel deletion logs, if set, I will send a message to this channel when another channel is deleted.
channelsLogsChannelUpdate: The channel for channel update logs, if set, I will send a message to this channel when any channel (including this one) gets updated in any way. This message will contain the changes made to the channel.
channelsLogsEmojiCreate: The channel for emoji creation logs, if set, I will send a message when an emoji has been created.
channelsLogsEmojiDelete: The channel for emoji deletion logs, if set, I will send a message when an emoji is deleted.
channelsLogsEmojiUpdate: The channel for emoji update logs, if set, I send a message when an emoji is updated in any way. This message will contain the changes made to the emoji.
channelsLogsImage: The channel for the image logs, if set, I will forward every message that has an image or a video to it.
channelsLogsMemberAdd: The channel I will send a message to when a member joins.
channelsLogsMemberRemove: The channel I will send a message to  when a member leaves, is kicked, or is banned.
channelsLogsMemberNickNameUpdate: The channel I will send a message to when a member changes their nickname.
channelsLogsMemberUserNameUpdate: The channel I will send a message to when a member changes their username.
channelsLogsMemberRolesUpdate: The channel I will send a message to when a member gets or loses a role.
channelsLogsMessageDelete: The channel I will send a message to when a message has been deleted.
channelsLogsMessageDeleteNsfw: The channel I will send a message to when a message from an NSFW channel has been deleted.
channelsLogsMessageUpdate: The channel I will send a message to when a message has been updated.
channelsLogsMessageUpdateNsfw: The channel I will send a message to when a message from an NSFW channel has been updated.
channelsLogsModeration: The channel for moderation logs, once enabled, I will post all my moderation cases there. If `events.ban-remove` and/or `events.ban-remove` are enabled, I will automatically post anonymous logs.
channelsLogsPrune: The channel for prune logs, same requirement as normal message logs, but will only send prune messages.
channelsLogsReactionEmojiAdd: The channel for the reaction logs, if set, I will send a message when the first reaction of an emoji is added to a message. Toggle `logs.reaction-emoji-include-twemoji` to include the default emojis.
channelsLogsReactionEmojiRemove: The channel for the removed reaction logs, if set, I will send a message when a reaction is removed from a message. Toggle `logs.reaction-emoji-include-twemoji` to include the default emojis.
channelsLogsReactionEmojiIncludeTwemoji: Whether the reaction logs should include the default (Twemoji) emojis.
channelsLogsRoleCreate: The channel for role creation logs, if set, I send a message when a new role is craeted.
channelsLogsInvites: The channel for invite logs, if set, I send a message when an invite is created or deleted.
greetingsJoinChannel: The channel I greet the members who join in.
greetingsJoinMessages: The messages I greet a member who joins with, one picked at random. Write %user% to mention them, %username% for their name, %server% and %memberCount% for the server, and \n for a new line.
greetingsJoinDirect: Whether I greet a member who joins in a direct message instead of the join channel.
greetingsLeaveChannel: The channel I say goodbye to the members who leave in.
greetingsLeaveMessages: The messages I say goodbye with, one picked at random. The same placeholders as the join messages work.
channelsLogsThreads: The channel for thread logs, if set, I send a message when a thread is created, deleted, renamed, archived or locked.
channelsLogsEvents: The channel for scheduled event logs, if set, I send a message when an event is created, changed, started, ended or deleted.
channelsLogsExpressions: The channel for sticker and sound logs, if set, I send a message when a sticker or a soundboard sound is created, changed or deleted.
channelsLogsIntegrations: The channel for app and webhook logs, if set, I send a message when an app is added or removed, and when the webhooks of a channel change.
channelsLogsRoleDelete: The channel for role deletion logs, if set, I send a message when a role is deleted.
channelsLogsRoleUpdate: The channel for role update logs, if set, I send a message when a role is updated in any way. This message will contain the changes made to the role.
channelsLogsServerUpdate: The channel for server update logs, if set, I send a message when the server is updated in any way. This message will contain the changes made to the server.
dashboardOnlyKey: This key can only be configured through [the web dashboard](https://wolfstar.rocks)
disabledChannels: A list of channels for disabled commands, for example, setting up a channel called general will forbid all users from using my commands there. Moderators+ override this purposely to allow them to moderate without switching channels.
disabledCommands: The disabled commands, core commands may not be disabled, and moderators will override this. All commands must be in lower case.
eventsBanAdd: This event posts non-bot moderation logs when a user gets banned. You must set up `channels.moderation-logs`.
eventsBanRemove: This event posts non-bot moderation logs when a user gets unbanned. You must set up `channels.moderation-logs`.
eventsTwemojiReactions: Whether or not twemoji reactions are posted in the reaction logs channel.
honeypotChannel: The honeypot channel, a trap for spam bots: no member has a reason to write there, so I act on whoever does and delete what they sent. Nobody is caught while this is not set, and the moderators never are. Set it up with `/honeypot setup`.
honeypotLogChannel: The channel I report every member the honeypot caught to, with what they sent, if any. The case still goes to the moderation logs.
honeypotAction: What I do to who writes in the honeypot channel: `Kick`, `Softban` (a ban and an unban, which also deletes what they sent in the other channels in the last hour) or `Ban`.
honeypotDirectMessage: Whether I tell the members the honeypot catches why, in a direct message. A hacked account that is softbanned can come back once its owner has it again.
honeypotWarning: Whether I keep a message in the honeypot channel that warns the members not to write there. Without it the channel says nothing, which is harder for a bot to learn to avoid, and for a member too.
honeypotRandomName: Whether I give the honeypot channel another name every day, so the bots cannot avoid it by its name.
honeypotKeepActive: Whether I send a message to the honeypot channel every day, so it does not look abandoned.
language: The language I will use for your server. It may not be available in the language you want.
timezone: The time zone of your server, by its name in the IANA database, such as `Europe/Rome` or `America/New_York`. It is `UTC` until you set one.
updatesChannel: The channel where I send announcements about WolfStar updates, new features, and maintenance notices for your server.
logsMessageUpdateStyle: How the log of an edited message shows the change. `Difference` is one text with what was removed struck through and what was added in bold, `Separate` shows the content before and the content after, each in a block of its own.
logsWebhooks: Whether I send the logs through a webhook of their channel, which I create the first time I have something to send there. You can then change its name and its avatar in the settings of the channel. Without the **Manage Webhooks** permission in a channel I send its logs as I do now. The moderation log and the reports are always sent as my own messages.
messagesIgnoreChannels: The channels configured to not increase the point counter for users.
messagesModerationAutoDelete: Whether or not moderation commands should be auto-deleted or not.
messagesModerationDm: Whether or not I should send a direct message to the target user on moderation actions.
messagesModerationMessageDisplay: Whether or not a response should be sent for moderation commands.
messagesModerationReasonDisplay: Whether the reason will be displayed in moderation commands.
messagesModeratorNameDisplay: Whether or not I should display the name of the moderator who took the action when sending the target user a moderation message. Requires `messages.moderation-dm` to be enabled.
rolesAdmin: The administrator roles. Administrators have access to all moderation and management commands. Defaults to anyone with the {{MANAGE_GUILD, permissions}} permission.
rolesInitial: The initial role, if configured, I will give it to users as soon as they join.
rolesInitialHumans: If configured, I will give this role to regular users upon joining. (not bots)
rolesInitialBots: If configured, I will give this role to bot users upon joining.
rolesModerator: The moderator roles. Moderators have access to almost all moderation commands. Defaults to anyone who can ban members.
reportsChannel: The channel the reports of the members are sent to. Members report a message or a user from the Apps menu or with `/report`, and nothing can be reported while this is not set.
reportsRole: The role I mention when a report arrives, if any.
reportsAnonymous: Whether the reports hide who made them from the moderators. I still know, so a member can be blocked from reporting from the menu of one of their reports.
reportsNotify: Whether I tell the member who made a report, in a direct message, when the moderators act on it or dismiss it.
rolesMuted: The muted role, if configured, I will give new muted users this role. Otherwise I will prompt you the creation of one.
rolesPublic: The public roles. These can be claimed by any user using the `roles` command.
rolesRemoveInitial: Whether claiming a public role should remove the initial role at the same time.
rolesRestrictedAttachment: The role that is used for the restrictAttachment moderation command
rolesRestrictedEmbed: The role that is used for the restrictEmbed moderation command.
rolesRestrictedEmoji: The role that is used for the restrictEmoji moderation command.
rolesRestrictedReaction: The role that is used for the restrictReaction moderation command.
rolesRestrictedVoice: The role that is used for the restrictVoice moderation command.
suggestionsChannel: The channel where suggestions will be sent.
suggestionsOnActionDm: If this setting is enabled, Skyra will DM the suggestion's author every time it is updated.
suggestionsOnActionHideAuthor: This setting allows you to update suggestions anonymously. It will substitute the updater's name with either `An administrator` or `A moderator`, according to their permission level.
suggestionsOnActionRePost: If this setting is enabled, Skyra will repost the suggestion's message every time it is updated. If it is disabled, it will edit the original message.
validationChooseKey: You cannot configure a group, please pick one of the following keys: {{keys, list(conjunction)}}.
validationMissingValue: The value ``{{value}}`` was not set in the key **{{path}}**.
validationDuplicatedValue: The value for the key `{{path}}` was already set to ``{{value}}``!
modulesAutomod: Whether the auto-moderation module is enabled.
modulesModeration: Whether the moderation module is enabled.
modulesLogs: Whether the logs module is enabled.
modulesCommands: Whether the commands module is enabled.
modulesRoles: Whether the roles module is enabled.
automodChannel: The channel where the auto-moderation actions are reported.
automodTrackNative: Whether I should also report the actions taken by Discord's native AutoMod.
moderationTrackBans: Whether I should record the bans made without using my commands.
moderationTrackTimeouts: Whether I should record the timeouts made without using my commands.
moderationTrackRoles: Whether I should record the muted and restriction roles given or taken away without using my commands. A muted role given by hand mutes the member as `/mute add` does: their other roles are taken away and kept, and they are given back when the role is taken away.
moderationTrackKicks: Whether I should record the kicks made without using my commands. It takes a request to the audit log for every member that leaves, so it is off until you turn it on.
moderationConfirmRecentMinutes: When a member already has a case made within these minutes, I ask the moderator to confirm before taking another action on them, so two moderators acting on one message do not punish twice. 0 never asks.
channelsIgnoreMessages: The channels where I will not log the message edits and deletions.
channelsIgnoreVoiceActivity: The channels I should ignore when reporting activity changes.
channelsLogsVoiceChannel: The channel for voice channel logs, if set, I send a message when a user joins, leaves, or moves to another voice channel.
eventsTimeout: This event posts non-bot moderation logs when a user's timeout status changes. You must set up `channels.moderation-logs`.
eventsUnknownMessages: Whether or not I should post updates on unknown command messages.
eventsIncludeBots: Whether or not I should ignore bots in the server logs.
